manual.expectation: Google and Discord are enabled. Email-password, phone, and anonymous sign-ins are disabled.
The site, console, admin, and authorized staging origins are the only OAuth redirect origins.
The report Pages Function has a report_ingress JWT, separate Turnstile and fingerprint secrets, the reviewed hostname allowlist, and no service-role key.
The share_reports and takedown_notices webhooks queue notification work through the deployed share-report function with its secret header and database-event idempotency keys.
